text:
raj-recruiter: Heads-up — candidate Vega (exec IC) has accepted verbally but needs a comp-band exception + sign-on split due to relocation tax rules. Proposed total OTE: $320k (base 200k / target 80k / sign-on 40k). Requesting: elevate to band E6 (comp committee approval) and allow sign-on paid 50% now / 50% after 6 months to handle home-country tax withholding. Start date: 2026-04-15, could be flexible by 1 week.

nina-peopleops: Thanks. Can you drop the offer packet + relocation tax memo here? We need the approvals matrix and justification for band uplift (market comp comp data). Also confirm manager sign-off.

lina-hm: I (Lina) confirm manager sign-off. Vega is a strategic hire — multiple competing offers, needs earlier start. Market comp comp data attached in DM.

raj-recruiter: Attached doc uploaded to GDrive: `gdrive.com/vega-offer-packet` and `gdrive.com/vega-tax-memo`. Justification: internal parity gap and scarcity in this skillset.

maria-legal: Quick note — splitting sign-on payments across countries can trigger dual-withholding. We'll need local tax counsel confirmation. Please include proposed payment schedule in the request so legal can review.

tim-finance: Finance needs total cashflow impact and budget code. Raj — can you confirm first-year cash paid in USD and if sign-on will be grossed up? Also, provide the hiring team's cost-center: ENG-PLAT-02.

raj-recruiter: First-year cash: base pro-rated (~$83k for Apr-Dec) + full sign-on first tranche $20k now + second tranche $20k in 6 months. Not grossing up by default — open to discussion if required by legal. Budget code: ENG-PLAT-02.

offer-bot: Approval request created: https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-0423-77. Approvers: nina-peopleops, comp-committee (chair: joel-comp), tim-finance, maria-legal. Current status: Pending.

nina-peopleops: OK routing to comp committee. I'll add the market comp sheet and the relocation tax memo to the packet and mark as "Urgent — executive IC". @joel-comp can you triage?

joel-comp (not in thread list): (joins thread) Will review today. If committee approves band uplift, I'll add conditional sign-on schedule language and escalation path for tax gross-up.

nina-peopleops: Great — thanks everyone. I'll keep the candidate updated: asking for 72-hr hold while approvals finish. :thumbsup:
